items.title: If a direct sum of two objects of the derived category of a ringed site has tor amplitude in a given interval, so does each summand
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is the additivity observation for tor amplitude (statement lines 12603-12608). The proof (proof lines 12610-12612) is the single sentence that the Tor functors are additive: Tor of K + L with any F splits as Tor(K, F) + Tor(L, F), so vanishing outside the interval for the sum forces the same vanishing for each summand. H2: immediate from additivity of Tor. Same-name restatement check: the same label occurs in the chapters cohomology.tex (ringed spaces) and more-algebra.tex (rings), both special cases of the ringed-site setting; the ringed-site version is the more general one and is the one counted here.
